'''Berserker Armor''' is an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] set. It can be crafted after reaching {{Coll|Red Sand VII}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
The '''Berserker Armor''' requires  {{Item|Enchanted Red Sand Cube|amount=13}}s,  {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=160}}s and {{Item|Burning Eye|amount=150}}s to craft.
